newsitem.title: USA: Edison Bros December same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Edison Bros December same store sales up.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Thursday that its same store sales for the five weeks ended January 4 rose 0.3 percent.
The company said this represents a $500,000 increase in same-store sales, which were $146.4 million for December 1996, up from $145.9 million for the month in 1995.
Total December 1996 sales of $165.9 million reflected a decline of $49.0 million, or 22.8 percent, from December 1995 total sales of $214.9 million.
Edison Brothers said it operated an average of 1,871 stores during the period this year, 29.3 percent fewer than the 2,648 stores included in its December 1995 total sales.
Same-store sales for the 48-week period ended January 4 were $967.3 million, down $25.4 millino or 2.6 percent from same-store sales of $992.7 million in 1995.
Total year-to-date sales were $1.03 billion, down $266.8 million or 20.8 percent from $1.30 billion a year ago.
"Edison Brothers' sales results for December were in line with our expectations," Alan Miller, chairman, said in a statement.
